description: This file defines the RegisterForm class for handling user registration forms in Drupal, including form building, submission, and saving user accounts.

classes.name: RegisterForm
classes.description: Form handler class for user registration, extending AccountForm, managing registration form display, submission, and user account creation.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the registration form, setting default values, permissions, and activation status based on user access.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Defines form actions, customizing the submit button label.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, generates password if needed, and prepares user data for saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the user account, sends notifications, and manages post-registration redirects and messages.
